legs: Single continuous cinematic drone flight, no cuts. The camera glides forward over the misty lake toward the shore, then rises smoothly up the green hillside and arrives high above a small village of twelve homes scattered across the slope around a central garden with a pool, a vaulted pavilion and a big tree.

Single continuous cinematic camera move, no cuts. The camera glides over the village and descends smoothly between the scattered homes down to eye level on a quiet gravel lane, gliding forward toward a tall rammed earth wall with a wooden door and an old oak tree.
